commands.quality_trim: python -m cutadapt --cores 1 --quality-cutoff 20 --json reports/01_quality.cutadapt.json --output intermediate/01_quality_trimmed.R1.fastq --paired-output intermediate/01_quality_trimmed.R2.fastq raw.R1.fastq raw.R2.fastq
commands.adapter_trim: python -m cutadapt --cores 1 --adapter AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA -A AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT --overlap 8 --error-rate 0.1 --json reports/02_adapter.cutadapt.json --output intermediate/02_adapter_trimmed.R1.fastq --paired-output intermediate/02_adapter_trimmed.R2.fastq intermediate/01_quality_trimmed.R1.fastq intermediate/01_quality_trimmed.R2.fastq
commands.length_filter: python -m cutadapt --cores 1 --minimum-length 75 --pair-filter any --too-short-output rejected/rejected_pairs.R1.fastq --too-short-paired-output rejected/rejected_pairs.R2.fastq --json reports/03_length_filter.cutadapt.json --output retained/retained_pairs.R1.fastq --paired-output retained/retained_pairs.R2.fastq intermediate/02_adapter_trimmed.R1.fastq intermediate/02_adapter_trimmed.R2.fastq
commands.alignment: bowtie2 --end-to-end --very-sensitive --seed 0 --reorder -p 1 --fr -I 0 -X 1000 --rg-id SRR13921545 --rg SM:SRR13921545 --rg LB:EK02-dnaseq --rg PL:ILLUMINA -x index/reference -1 retained/retained_pairs.R1.fastq -2 retained/retained_pairs.R2.fastq | samtools view --no-PG -b - | samtools sort --no-PG -@ 1 -o trimmed_paired.sorted.bam -

notes.prefix_validation: The first 5,000 R1 and R2 records exactly match the Project 11 SHA-256 checksums.
notes.large_artifacts: FASTQ, BAM, BAI, and position-level depth artifacts remain local and are not committed.
notes.duplicate_marking: Duplicate marking and the post-duplicate depth check are deferred to Milestone 2.
